3351756.name: Chabad at Rollins College
3351756.note: Chabad.org, 31 Oct 2017 ('Doubling Presence in a Decade, 14 New Chabad Campus Centers Opened This Year'): 'The Sasonkins arrived in Winter Park, Fla., at the end of 2016 to establish a new Chabad House for the more than 1,000 Jewish college students in this area just outside of Orlando'; they also serve Full Sail University (Rabbi Shmuli and Chayala Sasonkin).

405421.name: Mikvah Shulamit
405421.note: The Jewish Week (Lisa Keys, 16 Jan 2003; on jewishjournal.com): 'Since it opened at the beginning of last year, Mikveh Shulamit has been the talk of the Florida town'; Rabbi Mendy Posner of Chabad oversees it; the same building houses the Contour Day Spa. Lubavitch.com (30 Dec 2002, 'A Perfect Package at Contour Day Spa') agrees: some eight years after the Posners came to Plantation it still had no mikveh, until the spa's owner proposed one; it was completed 18 months later and its opening drew nearly seventy women.

405403.name: Mikvah
405403.note: Lubavitch.com, 4 June 2007: a 165-ton crane from a neighboring construction site fell at about 4 a.m. on the Saturday (2 June 2007) onto 'a magnificent mikveh building completed only a year and a half earlier' (count back: about late 2005), a few doors from the shul of Chabad Lubavitch of Fort Lauderdale (Rabbi Moishe Meir and Penina Lipszyc); the rabbi hoped to reopen by Rosh Hashana. The chabad.org listing (405403) is also from about 2005. Count-back only: medium.

821426.name: Mesivta of Coral Springs
821426.note: COLlive, 2 Sept 2008 (2 Elul 5768): 'Coral Springs, Florida newest Mesivta opened with bochurim making a good impression on locals'. CrownHeights.info, 14 April 2009, the Mesivta's own notice: 'Due to the amazing hatzlacha of our first year ... we are opening a Shiur Beis' (Rabbis Chaim Dovid Janowski, Rosh Yeshiva; Yankie Denburg; Yankie Sheinberger). Against: Chabad.org (Feb 2012) has it celebrating 'its fifth year' (its first graduating class in 2011). The chabad.org listing (821426) is from about 2008.
